question_text: Will Yale drop in national university rankings?
resolution_criteria:
If Yale drops in the rankings, then the market resolves to Yes.
All that matters is the rank associated with the college/university -- even if a single university goes from being alone in first place to being tied for first place, that is not a drop in ranking. The 2026 Best National University Rankings are expected to be released in September 2025.
